evidence.exact_span: The remuneration policy is to provide terms of employment such that the recruitment, motivation and retention of high calibre personnel is achieved and maintained to the mutual benefit of shareholders and employees.
Performance bonuses of £500,000 to each of the group chief executive and group finance director were paid during the year. These related to the 2021 financial year.
Performance is determined by index-linked profit improvements through a trend of earnings per share growth.
